question: HCC microenvironment: which T-cell states are enriched?

question: Healthy liver zonation: which functions mark pericentral (zone 3) hepatocytes?

question: Healthy liver zonation: which functions mark periportal (zone 1) hepatocytes?

question: Fetal liver: what distinguishes it from adult liver?
gold_answer: AFP+ hepatoblasts plus active intrahepatic hematopoiesis.

question: Liver regeneration after partial hepatectomy: initiating signals?

question: PBC: which cells are primarily injured?

question: PSC: characteristic lesion?

gold_answer: KRT19+ EPCAM+ cholangiocyte-lineage malignant ductal cells.
gold_source: Banales et al., Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2020 (CCA)

question: Chronic biliary injury: what is the ductular reaction?
gold_answer: Expansion of KRT7+/KRT19+ reactive ductular/progenitor cells at the portal-parenchymal interface.

question: MASLD progression in liver sinusoidal endothelial cells: early change?
gold_answer: LSEC capillarization — loss of fenestrae and of the scavenger phenotype.
gold_source: DeLeve, Compr Physiol 2015; Poisson et al., J Hepatol 2017

question: MASH hepatocytes: characteristic injured cell morphology?
gold_answer: Ballooned hepatocytes with Mallory-Denk bodies.
gold_source: Brunt & Tiniakos, Semin Liver Dis 2015 (MASH histology)

question: Alcohol-associated hepatitis: dominant inflammatory cell?
gold_answer: Neutrophilic infiltration with hepatocyte ballooning and cholestasis.
gold_source: Lucey et al., N Engl J Med 2009 (AH); Crabb et al., Hepatology 2020

question: Cirrhotic liver: what happens to mesothelial/capsular GPM6A+ cells in MASH-fibrosis?
gold_answer: GPM6A+ mesothelial cells expand and contribute to the scar niche.

question: Liver fibrosis regression: which cells degrade scar ECM?
gold_answer: Restorative Ly6C-lo macrophages expressing matrix metalloproteinases.
gold_source: Ramachandran et al., Hepatology 2012; Tacke & Zimmermann, J Hepatol 2014

question: HCC malignant hepatocytes vs healthy: core expression shift?
gold_answer: Dedifferentiation — loss of mature metabolic/zonation programs, gain of proliferation programs (AFP re-expression in a subset).
gold_source: Craig et al., Cold Spring Harb Perspect Med 2018; Aizarani et al., Nature 2019

question: Which enzyme catalyses the rate-limiting step of the urea cycle in hepatocytes?
gold_answer: Carbamoyl-phosphate synthase 1 (CPS1), periportal (zone 1).
gold_source: Morris, Annu Rev Genomics Hum Genet 2002 (urea cycle)

question: Statin treatment upregulates which hepatic receptor via SREBP2 feedback?
gold_answer: LDLR — sterol depletion activates SREBP2, increasing LDL receptor expression.
gold_source: Goldstein & Brown, Arterioscler Thromb Vasc Biol 2009

question: How does the intestine-liver FGF19 axis regulate bile-acid synthesis?
gold_answer: Ileal FXR induces FGF19, which signals through hepatic FGFR4/beta-Klotho to repress CYP7A1.

question: Which transporter exports bile salts across the canalicular membrane?
gold_answer: BSEP (ABCB11).

question: Wilson disease is caused by mutations in which gene?
gold_answer: ATP7B — impaired biliary copper excretion and ceruloplasmin loading.

question: Hereditary haemochromatosis classically involves which gene?
gold_answer: HFE (C282Y) — inappropriately low hepcidin, iron overload.

question: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency: which gene and variant class cause liver disease?
gold_answer: SERPINA1, PiZ (E342K) polymer accumulation in hepatocyte ER.

question: Where do Kupffer cells originate in steady state?
gold_answer: Embryonic (yolk-sac/fetal-liver) origin, self-renewing resident macrophages.
gold_source: Schulz et al., Science 2012; Gomez Perdiguero et al., Nature 2015

question: What distinguishes liver sinusoidal endothelial cells from continuous endothelium?
gold_answer: Open fenestrae grouped in sieve plates and lack of a basement membrane.
gold_source: Wisse et al., Hepatology 1985; Poisson et al., J Hepatol 2017

question: Where do quiescent hepatic stellate cells store vitamin A?
gold_answer: Cytoplasmic lipid droplets in the space of Disse.
gold_source: Wake, Am J Anat 1971; Friedman, Hepatology 2008

question: Which signaling pathway specifies the cholangiocyte lineage, mutated in Alagille syndrome?
gold_answer: Notch — JAG1 (or NOTCH2) mutations cause bile-duct paucity.
gold_source: Li et al., Nat Genet 1997; McDaniell et al., Am J Hum Genet 2006

question: Which transcription factor is the master regulator of hepatocyte identity?
gold_answer: HNF4A.
gold_source: Li et al., EMBO J 2000 (hepatocyte identity); Parviz et al., Nat Genet 2003

question: Which pathway drives pericentral metabolic zonation?
gold_answer: Wnt/beta-catenin — APC loss or CTNNB1 activation expands zone-3 programs.

question: Which cytokine pathway primes hepatocyte proliferation after partial hepatectomy?
gold_answer: IL-6/STAT3 (with TNF/NF-kB priming).

question: Which pathway limits liver size; its loss causes organ overgrowth?
gold_answer: Hippo — YAP/TAZ activation drives hepatomegaly.
gold_source: Camargo et al., Curr Biol 2007; Lee et al., Genes Dev 2010

question: How does insulin stimulate hepatic lipogenesis?
gold_answer: AKT-dependent activation of SREBP1c, inducing FASN/ACC.
gold_source: Horton et al., J Clin Invest 2002

question: Which transcription factor induces lipogenesis in response to glucose?
gold_answer: ChREBP (MLXIPL).

question: Which nuclear receptor drives the fasting fatty-acid oxidation program including CPT1A?
gold_answer: PPARA.
gold_source: Kersten et al., J Clin Invest 1999; Rakhshandehroo et al., J Lipid Res 2010

question: Which proteins are essential for hepatic VLDL assembly and secretion?
gold_answer: MTTP (lipidation) and APOB (particle scaffold).
gold_source: Hussain et al., J Lipid Res 2008

question: Acetaminophen hepatotoxicity: which enzyme generates NAPQI and what is depleted?
gold_answer: CYP2E1 (plus CYP1A2/3A4); glutathione is depleted, then N-acetylcysteine rescues.

question: Which enzyme conjugates bilirubin; its mild deficiency causes Gilbert syndrome?
gold_answer: UGT1A1.
gold_source: Bosma et al., N Engl J Med 1995

question: Which mitochondrial enzyme drives hepatic ketogenesis during fasting?
gold_answer: HMGCS2.

question: Which hepatocyte-secreted hormone regulates systemic iron via ferroportin degradation?
gold_answer: Hepcidin (HAMP).

question: Which receptor internalizes LDL particles in hepatocytes and is degraded by PCSK9?
gold_answer: LDLR; PCSK9 targets it for lysosomal degradation.

question: First-pass metabolism of many drugs uses which abundant zone-3 CYP?
gold_answer: CYP3A4.

question: Periportal gluconeogenesis: name the two rate-limiting enzymes.
gold_answer: PEPCK (PCK1) and glucose-6-phosphatase (G6PC).

question: What is the predominant plasma protein secreted by hepatocytes?
gold_answer: Albumin (ALB), the main determinant of plasma oncotic pressure.

question: Which clotting factors require vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation by hepatocytes?
gold_answer: Factors II, VII, IX, X (plus protein C/S).

question: During fibrosis resolution, which macrophage phenotype clears scar matrix?
gold_answer: Ly6C-low restorative macrophages secreting MMPs.

question: Which ligand-receptor pair is the canonical hepatocyte growth signal for regeneration?
gold_answer: HGF-MET.

question: You have 50 uncharacterized compounds. How would you use the virtual liver to prioritize them for steatosis risk?
gold_answer: Run compound_perturbation across hepatocyte contexts, score lipid-handling program shifts, and cross-check each compound against the DILIrank library tool for known severity labels.
gold_source: HepaDiff v4 agent tool documentation (compound_perturbation, query_drug_library)

question: How would you test whether a compound's hepatocyte effect is on-target?
gold_answer: Query the drug-target annotation, knock out the annotated target gene in the same cell type, and compare the gene-knockout delta with the compound delta.
gold_source: HepaDiff v4 agent tool documentation (query_drug_target, knockout, compound_perturbation)

question: A new MASLD GWAS locus is published. How do you find which liver cell type mediates it?
gold_answer: Score the locus gene program across cell types with the GWAS-program module and rank cell types by program enrichment.

question: How would you simulate disease progression along the MASLD spectrum in stellate cells?
gold_answer: Use generate_condition across the healthy-MASLD-MASH-fibrosis condition ladder and track fibrogenic program shifts per stage.

question: A knockout result was obtained in mouse. How do you check its human translatability with this platform?
gold_answer: Run the species-comparison module on the same perturbation and compare direction and magnitude of the effect across species.
gold_source: HepaDiff v4 agent tool documentation (species module)

question: A user asks for a knockout prediction of a gene absent from the trained vocabulary. What should the agent do?
gold_answer: Refuse/abstain and state the limitation explicitly; optionally suggest using a trained paralog or designing the question around trained genes.
gold_source: HepaDiff v4 agent tool documentation (capability boundary / abstention policy)

question: How would you identify which liver cell type a new compound injures first?
gold_answer: Run compound_perturbation across a panel of liver cell types and rank cell types by injury-signature score.
gold_source: HepaDiff v4 agent tool documentation (compound_perturbation, injury signature)

question: How can you assess the robustness of a virtual knockout prediction?
gold_answer: Generate across multiple random seeds and use the uncertainty/abstention readout; high uncertainty calls for withholding the conclusion.
gold_source: HepaDiff v4 agent tool documentation (uncertainty, abstention)

question: How would you find candidate ligand-receptor pairs mediating macrophage-to-stellate crosstalk in MASH?
gold_answer: Query the ligand-receptor database tool for macrophage ligands with stellate-expressed receptors, then test the niche effect with condition generation.
gold_source: HepaDiff v4 agent tool documentation (query_ligand_receptor, generate_condition)

question: How would you validate that a generated MASH stellate cell population is realistic?
gold_answer: Check the fibrogenic marker program (COL1A1/ACTA2 up, vitamin-A storage lost) against the published single-cell literature rather than against the model itself.
gold_source: Ramachandran et al., Nature 2019; Guilliams et al., Cell 2022 (independent reference atlases)

question: How would you use the platform to nominate DILI-risk compounds among vMost-labelled drugs with trained targets?
gold_answer: Screen the DILIrank vMost subset whose annotated targets are in the trained vocabulary, compare each target-knockout delta with the compound delta, and rank by concordance.
gold_source: HepaDiff v4 agent tool documentation + DILIrank v2 subsetting rule

question: How would you link a virtual knockout program to HCC patient prognosis?
gold_answer: Score the knockout-induced program on TCGA-LIHC expression data and test survival association with the survival module.
gold_source: HepaDiff v4 agent tool documentation (survival module, TCGA-LIHC)

question: What happens to hepatic fatty-acid synthesis when FASN is knocked out?
gold_answer: De novo lipogenesis collapses; malonyl-CoA/palmitate output drops.
gold_source: Chakravarthy et al., Cell Metab 2005 (liver FASN)

question: Predict the hepatocyte consequence of CPT1A knockout.
gold_answer: Mitochondrial long-chain fatty-acid oxidation is blocked; lipid accumulates, ketogenesis falls.
gold_source: Schreurs et al., Biochim Biophys Acta 2010 (CPT1A)

question: What is the expected plasma-relevant consequence of hepatocyte LDLR knockout?
gold_answer: LDL particle clearance fails; plasma LDL rises (familial-hypercholesterolemia phenotype).

question: Knock out MBOAT7 in hepatocytes: which lipid pathway is affected?
gold_answer: Phosphatidylinositol acyl-chain remodelling (Lands cycle), linked to MASLD risk.
gold_source: Mancina et al., Gastroenterology 2016; Helsley et al., Cell Metab 2019

question: What cellular phenotype follows hepatocyte ATP7B loss?
gold_answer: Copper accumulation with failure of biliary copper excretion (Wilson-disease mechanism).

question: Knocking out TGFB1 in the liver niche: what is lost?
gold_answer: The dominant pro-fibrogenic signal driving stellate activation and ECM deposition.

question: Hepatocyte STAT3 knockout: which regenerative signal is abrogated?
gold_answer: IL-6-driven acute-phase and regenerative priming response.

question: What hepatocyte pathway fails when JAK2 is knocked out?
gold_answer: Cytokine (IL-6 family/growth-hormone) signal transduction via STATs.
gold_source: Watowich et al., Annu Rev Cell Dev Biol 1996

question: What happens to hepatic zonation when CTNNB1 (beta-catenin) is knocked out?
gold_answer: Pericentral (zone-3) gene programs collapse; the liver takes on a periportal-like identity.

question: In the liver niche, what developmental process depends on NOTCH1/Notch signalling?
gold_answer: Cholangiocyte specification and bile-duct morphogenesis.

question: Knock out COL1A1 in activated stellate cells: what changes?
gold_answer: Loss of fibrillar type-I collagen deposition, the core scar component.

question: Removing IL6 from the niche: which hepatocyte response is blunted?
gold_answer: The acute-phase response and regenerative priming via IL-6R/gp130/STAT3.

question: Hepatocyte ACOX1 knockout: which organelle pathway is hit?
gold_answer: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids.

question: What happens to hepatocyte triglyceride synthesis when DGAT2 is knocked out?
gold_answer: Terminal triglyceride synthesis falls; lipid-droplet formation and steatosis are reduced.
gold_source: Stone et al., J Biol Chem 2004

question: Knock out ACACA (ACC1) in hepatocytes: what is the primary metabolic consequence?
gold_answer: Malonyl-CoA production stops, blocking de novo lipogenesis and releasing CPT1A inhibition.
gold_source: Mao et al., Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 2006
